fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSM): a $10,000 investment five years ago is now worth over $38,000, and the company holds 73% of the global foundry market share.
fields.summary_ko.1: IDC projects Foundry 2.0 market revenue will exceed $36.0 billion in 2026 and achieve 11% CAGR through 2030, with TSMC's addressable market potentially reaching nearly $55.0 billion by 2030.
